mintAuthority.summary: STAC uses issuer-administered native token issuance on Ethereum and Solana. On Ethereum, the token is a UUPS proxy whose DSToken implementation permits ISSUER-or-above accounts to mint; the current token-owner EOA is the trust service's unique MASTER and can both mint and authorize upgrades. On Solana, Token-2022 minting and freezing are controlled by the program-owned GSM7ZTDNByoGwayftzcSrDqWmMF9L3mU6KLVrca57j2M account through controller program 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP, whose program upgrade authority 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6 is a single system-owned keypair address with no timelock or on-chain threshold, shared with the controller that mints vbill-vaneck. The two-word on-chain Chronicle feed remains a price-per-share and timestamp feed. Chronicle's current off-chain proof payload also publishes outstanding shares and an Ethereum/Solana supply breakdown, superseding the August finding that no Solana liability data was published. Chronicle expressly disclaims attestation or audit of underlying records; the unknown reconciliation posture is retained pending review of the new payload's assurance and issuance-control scope.

review.evidence: Historical August 16-18, 2026 review: Ethereum owner 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee was an EOA with MASTER role and UUPS implementation 0x77684815f44b28726bc3efa4471b88ef3b93feb0. The Solana mint/freeze authority was GSM7ZTDNByoGwayftzcSrDqWmMF9L3mU6KLVrca57j2M under controller 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP, immediately replaceable by system-owned upgrade key 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6. Those adverse issuance and upgrade paths remain unchanged at Ethereum block 26095797 and finalized Solana slot 452212788 on 2026-10-01. Ethereum getRole(owner) remains 1, the correct EIP-1967 admin slot is zero, and the implementation is unchanged. Solana supply is 172413.444566 STAC, with the same active mint/freeze authority, controller and upgrade key. The August review moved reconciliation from continuous to unknown because the two-word Chronicle readWithAge feed exposed price per share and timestamp without supply or chain dimensions. That feed limitation remains true. The broader nondisclosure conclusion is superseded by the September 29 content-addressed proof and the primary dashboard's verification workflow inspected on October 1: the Chronicle Agent calculates NAV and shares, computes total fund value, signs the data and publishes it to IPFS; the validator network cross-checks agent output, reaches multi-validator agreement, and signs the proof. The workflow explicitly includes Ethereum and Solana supply against outstanding token supply, and the product states a daily Proof of Asset frequency. The proof publishes NAV 281895415.7, outstanding shares 272611.445342, Ethereum supply 100198.000776 and Solana supply 172413.444566. The two supply quantities also match the October 1 pinned Ethereum block 26098754 and finalized Solana slot 452347645 observations. This establishes periodic technical asset/share reconciliation, not transaction-by-transaction collateral enforcement or an independent audit of original custody records. Chronicle expressly disclaims attesting to, auditing or guaranteeing the underlying data, records or assets; assurance and issuance-control completeness remain unverified. Source date and proof-verification timestamp remain distinct. The BVI fund structure and U.S. private-placement exemptions do not establish product-level prudential supervision. Other issuer-level accounts, controller signer/governance semantics, off-chain issuance limits, and address-specific MPC/HSM custody of signing keys remain unresolved. The current signed proof dated October 19, 2026 again exactly joins native Ethereum 100681.005183 and Solana 172413.444566 shares to outstanding 273094.449749 and reports NAV 283150234.1. No denominator mismatch is alleged. Chronicle's current disclaimer explicitly disclaims attestation, audit or guarantee of underlying data, records and assets. The exact issuer SEC CIK 2095325 identifies only an exempt Form D offering, not a registered 1940 Act fund; current issuer offering, SEC filing and BVI FSC exact-name/CLO searches did not establish an alternative prudential token-issuance mandate.
